description: The models tried for ONE request, in the order they were tried, as a flow that ends in an Answer node — every attempt with its result, the reason it failed or was skipped, how long it took and when — plus an edit mode in which a reader reorders the chain, adds a model from the host's catalogue and removes one. The surface renders the run it is given and never polls or mutates the host's data: in the RUN view it only reads Attempts, and in the EDIT view it keeps its own working copy of Chain and reports every change through ChainChanged (a reorder through the shared TmSortableList, which supplies the pointer drag AND its keyboard and menu alternatives, WCAG 2.5.7). Accessibility: every attempt is a labelled node of an ordered list, its result is an ICON plus a localized WORD plus a tone (colour is never the only carrier), a failure or a skip always prints its reason, and the decorative arrows are aria-hidden because the list already carries the order. The table view carries exactly the same facts without the geometry, so a screen-reader, keyboard-only or phone reader loses nothing. ONE polite live region speaks only when the reader adds or removes a model — a reorder is narrated by the sortable list itself, so nothing is announced twice.

parameters.name: AllowRename
parameters.description: Whether the editor offers an inline rename of a chain entry's label. Default false — a host that never bound OnRename sees no rename button. The rename commits on Enter and rolls back on Escape; the host owns persistence.

parameters.name: Attempts
parameters.description: The attempts, in the order they were tried. Each entry is one node of the flow; null or empty renders the localized empty state, and a null entry inside the list is skipped. The component never mutates the list.

parameters.name: AvailableModels
parameters.description: The host's model catalogue, from which the editor offers what is NOT already in the chain. Null or empty renders the localized "no models are available" note and a disabled Add button.

parameters.name: Chain
parameters.description: The models in fallback order, two-way bound with ChainChanged (@bind-Chain). Null (the default) derives the chain from Attempts, which is what an editor opened over a finished run shows. A pinned list is copied, never mutated: the reader's reorder reports a NEW list through ChainChanged.

parameters.name: ChainChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new chain whenever the reader reorders, adds or removes a model.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the latencies and the attempt times. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: The heading level of the rendered title, clamped to 2–6. Default 3.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Whether the surface reports the run or edits the chain. Default View. The host owns this switch (it is not two-way): the component never changes it on its own.

parameters.name: OnRename
parameters.description: Fires with the committed rename (FallbackChainRenameArgs carrying the model id and the new label) when the reader commits an inline edit with Enter. Escape rolls back without raising this callback. The component updates its own working copy so the row shows the new label at once; the host applies the change to its own persistence.

parameters.name: Policy
parameters.description: The rule the chain follows, two-way bound with PolicyChanged (@bind-Policy). Default Pin, so an unset policy never falls back to another model by accident. The editor offers the three policies as a segmented radio group; the run view reports the value as a word.

parameters.name: PolicyChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new policy when the reader picks one in the editor.

parameters.name: ShowPolicy
parameters.description: Whether the policy is shown at all. Default true — the run view prints it as a read-out and the editor offers the radio group.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading is rendered. Default true.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The heading above the surface. Null renders the localized default ("Fallback chain"); the heading also names the surface, so the name a reader hears is the one they see.

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: The run presentation, two-way bound with ViewModeChanged (@bind-ViewMode). Default Flow. It applies to the run view; the editor has its own presentation.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the new presentation when the reader uses the View switcher.

examples.title: A run a host reports, and the editor over the same chain
The attempts a host recorded

notes: The run view only reads Attempts; the editor keeps its own copy of Chain and reports every change through ChainChanged (never mutating the host list).
The editor reorders through the shared TmSortableList, so the pointer drag, the keyboard grab/move/drop and the per-row move menu all work (WCAG 2.5.7).
Adding is limited to AvailableModels that are not already in the chain; removing and reordering keep the chain a sequence of distinct models.
ONE polite live region announces an add and a remove; a reorder is narrated by the sortable list itself, so nothing is announced twice.
The table view (ViewMode=Table) carries every attempt, result, reason, latency and time as text — the flow is never the only way to read the run.
An unmeasured latency is never invented: the flow omits it and the table says "not measured".
